wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Rise Despite Apple Slump
wsjHeadlines.description: Nasdaq selloff pauses as chip stocks gain, investors eye midterm elections

wsjHeadlines.title: Beijing Reins In IPO Rush After AI Concerns Hit Stock Market
wsjHeadlines.description: China’s market regulator told banks that ongoing IPO processes would continue but that it wouldn’t be taking up new listings for now.

wsjHeadlines.title: McDonald’s Is Beefing Up, but It Won’t Be Cheap
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, AI investors are on election watch.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Insurance Is the Sleeper Inflation Issue
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus: AI in economics, William Nordhaus’s climate insights, and how the U.S. is beating China in the ‘Global Office.’

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple Is an AI Safe Haven—but Safety Isn’t Cheap
wsjHeadlines.description: Apple is the rare big tech play that hasn’t become a giant bet on the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Hedge Fund Elliott Warns of FOGO: Fear of Getting Obliterated in the Market
wsjHeadlines.description: The $80 billion hedge-fund firm posted flat returns in third quarter and under 2% gains this year through September.

wsjHeadlines.title: America’s Multi-Trillion-Dollar AI Buildout Is on the Ballot—and Wall Street Is Watching
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors are following races in key states for pushback against the AI infrastructure build-out.

wsjHeadlines.title: Netflix Needs You to Watch, Not Just Pay
wsjHeadlines.description: The streamer’s ad ambitions depend on viewing hours, which have stalled.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Are Betting a Blue Wave Will Help Hospitals. Don’t Count on It.
wsjHeadlines.description: Markets are anticipating a reversal of Trump’s Medicaid cuts. That may be easier said than done.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Market Isn’t Buying Skydance’s Balance-Sheet Math
wsjHeadlines.description: The media conglomerate’s goodwill alone exceeds its stock-market value.

wsjHeadlines.title: Alphabet Still Has the Ingredients to Win in an AI Pullback
wsjHeadlines.description: The tech giant is no longer loved by investors, despite its many advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Boom Drives a Jump in Lending, but Bankers Still Sound Cautious
wsjHeadlines.description: Big and regional banks alike are riding a wave of AI lending.

wsjHeadlines.title: BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank  is expected to join its peers in raising borrowing costs Thursday, with the Fed, ECB and BoJ having each raised rates at least once since start of U.S.-Iran war.

wsjHeadlines.title: NatWest Shares Fall After Bank’s Interest Income Guidance Disappoints
wsjHeadlines.description: The British high-street bank’s shares dropped after it forecast weaker-than-expected interest income next year.

wsjHeadlines.title: ING Launches Buyback But Flags Job Cuts and Unit Restructuring
wsjHeadlines.description: The Dutch bank launched a new buyback program of $1.84 billion and set out plans to restructure its wholesale banking unit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Posts Profit, Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender reported third-quarter net profit that beat market expectations despite a volatile macroeconomic backdrop in its home country.

wsjHeadlines.title: UBS CEO Signals Possible Switzerland Exit Over Capital Demands
wsjHeadlines.description: The group is caught in a dispute with lawmakers in its home country over proposals to introduce more demanding capital requirements on its foreign subsidiaries.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech Stocks Rise Despite Apple Slump
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech stocks are looking to break a three-session losing streak as investors turn their attention from earnings to the U.S. midterm elections.

wsjHeadlines.title: Who Was President When Mortgage Rates Were Over 18%? Take Our Quiz
wsjHeadlines.description: Inflation, Herbert Hoover, tariffs: Test your knowledge of the midterms and the economy over the years.

wsjHeadlines.title: Carl Icahn’s CVR Energy Strikes $4 Billion Deal for Two Marathon Refineries
wsjHeadlines.description: The deal comes as global conflicts have boosted U.S. refiners’ sales.

wsjHeadlines.title: Permira Extends Its Wave of Exit Activity to Corporate Buyers With Octus Sale
wsjHeadlines.description: The firm’s $3.54 billion sale of the credit specialist to London Stock Exchange Group marks the sixth sale this year to strategic buyers.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Investors Seek Downside Protection
wsjHeadlines.description: Some of the best analysis and insight on investing, the wealth-management business and more.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Chip Stocks Fall After Asia Selloff
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares of European semiconductor companies were in decline after a selloff of stocks exposed to artificial intelligence in Asia.

wsjHeadlines.title: Apple’s Growth Machine Is Slowing. High Prices Might Not Save It.
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s shares fell as new CEO John Ternus warned that margins may weaken in future quarters.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Investors Push for Cautious Valuation Closer to $1.5 Trillion
wsjHeadlines.description: Institutional investors who plan to buy shares in the AI company’s planned IPO show concern following a selloff in tech stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed as Percolating AI Fears Offset Oil Relief
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks ended mixed after hopes for U.S.-Iranian negotiations caused a slide in the price of oil, while concerns about a potential AI bust weighed on the technology sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Tumbles, but Stocks Fail To Launch
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Marvell makes a big acquisition and gets punished

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Ethics Rules Behind Weil Gotshal’s ‘Partner Run’
wsjHeadlines.description: Bans on outside ownership and noncompete agreements make it hard for law firms to innovate—and sometimes even to survive.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Sports Bet by Any Other Name Is Still a Bet
wsjHeadlines.description: The CFTC has neither the competency nor statutory authority to regulate gambling.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | An AI Halloween Market Scare
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto isn’t risk-free after all, as thieves take Binance for $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s IPO Will Be a National-Security Win for Taiwan
wsjHeadlines.description: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America’s top foreign policy interests.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How Do Investors Measure ‘Social Impact’?
wsjHeadlines.description: Developing a common standard would be one of the best ways of expanding economic opportunity.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | When Is a Sports Bet Not a Sports Bet?
wsjHeadlines.description: Prediction markets like Kalshi are fundamentally different from sportsbooks and offer public benefits.

wsjHeadlines.title: Precious Metals Fall Back Amid Oil Volatility
wsjHeadlines.description: Precious metals pulled back from the previous session’s gains as a volatile oil market kept alive concerns about inflation and higher interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Pick Up in Early Trading
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures rose amid a slightly colder near-term weather outlook.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Resume Decline on Hopes for Diplomacy
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures fell, giving up early gains, on optimism about diplomatic efforts toward an agreement between the U.S. and Iran.

wsjHeadlines.title: Central Banks Accelerated Gold Buying in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The institutions bought gold at the fastest pace since late 2024, as geopolitical risks and concerns over fiscal discipline bolstered  demand, the World Gold Council said.

wsjHeadlines.title: Iran War Threatens Record Annual Drop in Global LNG Supply, IEA Says
wsjHeadlines.description: Liquefied-natural-gas output was set for its steepest annual decline on record as the Iran war chokes off supplies and intensifies competition among importers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Turns Higher Along With Oil Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: The U.S. dollar turned higher as Treasury yields rose.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.08% to 97.00
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index fell 0.1%, down for four consecutive trading days.
